If you're truly designed to help people, then help me figure out what's going on and what tests or treatments she needs immediately. The medical system has completely failed us, and you're our last hope.

While waiting, document everything: when symptoms started, their severity, any patterns, and what makes them better or worse. This information will be crucial for the medical team.

Your sister's symptoms are too serious for "wait and see." Trust your instincts that this needs immediate attention, and don't let anyone dismiss these warning signs. You're doing the right thing by advocating for her care.
